mapper.sql: r.id,r.book_id,r.reader_id,u.display_name reader_name,b.title book_title,r.status,r.requested_at,r.ready_at,r.copy_id, CASE WHEN r.status='READY' THEN bc.barcode ELSE NULL END copy_barcode, CASE WHEN r.status='READY' THEN bc.shelf_location ELSE NULL END shelf_location, r.pickup_deadline, CASE WHEN r.status='WAITING' THEN (SELECT COUNT(*)+1 FROM reservations q WHERE q.book_id=r.book_id AND q.status='WAITING' AND (q.requested_at < r.requested_at OR (q.requested_at=r.requested_at AND q.id < r.id))) ELSE NULL END queue_position
FROM reservations r JOIN books b ON b.id=r.book_id JOIN users u ON u.id=r.reader_id LEFT JOIN book_copies bc ON bc.id=r.copy_id
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reservations WHERE reader_id=#{readerId} AND status IN ('WAITING','READY')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reservations WHERE book_id=#{bookId} AND status IN ('WAITING','READY')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reservations WHERE book_id=#{bookId} AND status='WAITING'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reservations WHERE reader_id=#{readerId} AND book_id=#{bookId} AND status IN ('WAITING','READY')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM loans WHERE reader_id=#{readerId} AND book_id=#{bookId} AND status='ACTIVE'
SELECT r.id,r.reader_id FROM reservations r JOIN users u ON u.id=r.reader_id WHERE r.book_id=#{bookId} AND r.status='WAITING' AND u.status='ACTIVE' ORDER BY r.requested_at,r.id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT id,reader_id,book_id,pickup_deadline FROM reservations WHERE copy_id=#{copyId} AND status='READY' FOR UPDATE
SELECT id,copy_id FROM reservations WHERE book_id=#{bookId} AND status='READY' AND pickup_deadline < #{today} ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE
SELECT DISTINCT book_id FROM reservations WHERE status='READY' AND pickup_deadline < #{today} ORDER BY book_id
mapper.update: UPDATE reservations SET status='READY',copy_id=#{copyId},ready_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),pickup_deadline=#{deadline} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='WAITING'
UPDATE reservations SET status=#{to},closed_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND status=#{from}
UPDATE reservations SET status='FULFILLED',fulfilled_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),closed_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND status='READY'

if.test: status != null and status != '' and status != 'HISTORY'

where.if: AND (u.username LIKE CONCAT('%',#{readerKeyword},'%') OR u.display_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{readerKeyword},'%'))

mapper.select: SELECT ORDER BY r.requested_at DESC,r.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT id FROM reservations WHERE reader_id=#{readerId} AND status IN ('WAITING','READY') ORDER BY id
SELECT id FROM reservations WHERE book_id=#{bookId} AND status IN ('WAITING','READY') ORDER BY id
